items: Home bookings: the flight number is plain text; Live Status opens the flight's status
Live Status button back on every home booking
Times in full: Departs / Arrives, Departed / Arrived
Departure and arrival times on every home booking
Tap the flight number on a card for its live status
Home bookings show departure and arrival times (Departed / Arrived in green once it happens)
The camera in the search box: a clean red button
Header: "Air India Cargo" in a cleaner type, and "Signed in as" with your name in bold
Signed out: one header with a Log in button - the portal's second header row is gone
The plane photo shows under the header, above the Track box
The search box in the header is black now
New header: the search box with the camera inside it, and your account circle at the top right
Pull down at the top of the page to refresh (the reload button has gone)
Search: the camera is in its box too - tap for the camera, hold for Scan & Open
Home: the total shown as INR 35,732.45
Home: pieces, weight and ₹ total show within a second - asked straight from the portal, then kept for next time
Home: pieces, weight and total on new bookings' cards even with Battery Saver on (list refreshed hourly)
Home: compact booking cards - the status beside the route, more bookings on one screen
Home: My Bookings cards now look like All Bookings - total, pieces, weight, product, flights and Final on each card
Smoother: status checks no longer start while you scroll or type
Search: no loading line, and a status updates on its card without the list redrawing
Statuses show sooner across the app - delivered bookings no longer re-read every minute
Search: animated results, a spinner while a status is checked, and the status pops in
Search: statuses are checked first and tried again when a read fails - no more stuck on Checking
Search: every booking shows its status - older ones are checked as you search
Search: cancelled bookings no longer counted as flying today or not accepted, and shown in red
Search: a note or invoice just saved is found by its new words straight away
Search: a specimen invoice opens its PDF
Option sheets: long lines wrap again, and the status badge always shows
Search: darker look, View Details / Track / more in boxes, status in colour
Buttons have the same thin white edge as the Booking Summary tiles
Booking Summary shows the shipment's real status when opened from View Details (no more "Checking where it is…")
Capture AWB: the AWB number stays on one line
Buttons get a white edge and soft shine
Search: View Details and Track on every booking, with pieces, weight and goods shown
Search now finds your bookings even when the All Bookings list hasn't been saved, and finds them by shipper and consignee name
New Search: find any booking, flight, note, invoice or saved file by AWB, name, city or flight - tap the search button on the title bar
Notifications show the flight's date beside its departure time
Booking status is checked for 4 AWBs at once, so your bookings fill in faster
Notifications name the flight even when it leaves after midnight
A landed flight no longer reads "scheduled" again a day later
New bookings get their flight in the alert, however far down the list
Track Shipment no longer shows Departed for an offloaded shipment
Closed notifications show the cities too - AI-2487 · Delhi 8:40 AM → Port Blair 12:05 PM
Notifications show the flight with the cities in full - AI-2487 · Delhi → Port Blair - then its departure and arrival
